notes.title: 2025 Release Date Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone 👋,

We have some important news to tell you:

[h1]Release Date[/h1]

We wanted to take a moment to share an important update about Shadows of the Werewolf. After reviewing all the incredible feedback from Steam Next Fest and our amazing community, we’ve decided to take a little extra time and aim for a mid-2025 release, ensuring the game becomes everything we have envisioned and more. The final release date will be announced once we are confident in the finished product. This wasn’t an easy decision, but we truly believe this extra time will help us deliver an experience that exceeds your expectations.

Your feedback showed us how much you care about Shadows of the Werewolf, and its potential. This extra time will allow us to:

[b]Expand the world[/b] – adding new areas, more enemies, hidden discoveries and dynamic interactions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160037/ce395dba0e3120ae757404687fcad1952c979cc4.png[/img]

[b]Enhance gameplay mechanics[/b] – including  smarter AI, deeper combat systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160037/169133ffa555f3136d6a45704002509effc869d6.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160037/706573b6d270c28492b222a112ac0efc104782b5.png[/img]


[b]Refine the story, visuals & atmosphere[/b] – bringing a more immersive and haunting experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160037/abbfe2020ff0c4c0c4bfd64ade2ecd762ed3b30d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160037/25906196d4462d8180bca925a39f41f56e710124.png[/img]

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]

During development, we’ll be sharing new updates, videos, screenshots, and behind-the-scenes insights. We’re also planning beta access in 2025 to involve our community in fine-tuning the experience.

We can’t thank you enough for your support, patience, and passion. Shadows of the Werewolf is shaping up to be something truly special, and we’re committed to making it worth the wait.

Stay tuned for more updates soon, and don’t forget to play the demo if you haven’t done so yet! Also, be sure to wishlist the game on Steam to stay updated.

The Shadows of the Werewolf Team

notes.title: Update v0.86.9
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone! 👋

I’m excited to share the latest updates we’ve made to the demo:

[list] [*] [b]Copyright Issues Fixed:[/b] We have updated all the sounds in the demo, ensuring that content creators can now post videos without concerns about copyright issues. Songs requiring attribution have been properly credited within the demo's credits. You may add these attributions in your video descriptions, but it is not necessary, as they are already included in-game.

[*] [b]Combat Input Improvements:[/b] Interacting with weapons is now more intuitive when pressing action buttons.

[*] [b]Fixed Werewolf Hearing Issue:[/b] The Werewolf can now hear the player and react appropriately when attempting to open a door.

[*] [b]Removed Duplicate Werewolf in Final Cutscene:[/b] Fixed an issue where a duplicate Werewolf appeared in the last cutscene, along with a floating house object that could occasionally be seen.

[*] [b]Character Lip Animation Improvements:[/b] The character's mouth movements now work better across different frame rates. This feature still needs some polishing, but it has improved overall. [/list]

Thanks again for your support! If you’re feeling extra generous, we’d really appreciate it if you could leave a review on the [demo store page]. Your feedback means the world to us! 🌍


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3193100/Shadows_of_the_Werewolf_Demo/

Roger

notes.title: Update v0.86.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

We are excited to bring you a new update for our demo! This version includes several improvements and fixes based on your valuable feedback. Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] [b]Content Creator Notice:[/b] Added a notice for content creators regarding the use of the game's music in their creations.

[*] [b]For Those Who Have Already Made Content:[/b] If you have already made a video with the game's music and received a copyright strike, please reach out to us directly, and we will assist you in resolving the issue. Additionally, we recommend removing or muting the parts of the video with music for now to prevent copyright issues. We have already sought information from the music provider to find a solution.

[*] [b]For Those Planning to Create Content:[/b] If you want to create content with the demo in its current state or previous versions, please turn the music down completely in the audio settings to avoid potential copyright strikes.

[*] [b]Automatic Language Selection:[/b] The game now automatically chooses the initial language based on your system settings the first time the game launches.

[*] [b]Improved Input Detection:[/b] Fixed an issue where starting the game with a gamepad connected but using keyboard and mouse did not change the displayed UI prompts.

[*] [b]Enhanced Cutscene Experience:[/b] You can now fast-forward cutscenes for a while before skipping them entirely (Experimental: let us know what you think).

[*] [b]Player Model Fixes:[/b] Refined the character mesh model that did not look good during close-range attacks.

[*] [b]Better Healing Item Indicators:[/b] Improved signals to better indicate where you should place the healing item.

[*] [b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b] Adjusted difficulty with more healing items in certain difficulty levels, and combat adjusted by difficulty as well.

[*] [b]The Werewolf Character Intelligence:[/b] The werewolf character is now a bit more intelligent in combat.

[*] [b]Graphics Improvements:[/b] The game should run a bit faster due to some performance changes.

[*] [b]Fixed real-time lighting issues:[/b] when returning to the main menu and playing again. Lights now reset properly.
[/list]

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback! We're committed to making the game the best experience possible, and we couldn't do it without you.

Roger

notes.title: Smoother Animations and Enhanced Combat!
notes.content:
We've been refining the Shadows of the Werewolf demo, and here's what's new:

[list]
[*] [b]Smoother Animations:[/b] Running, attacking, impact reactions, and cutscenes now look and feel more fluid than ever.

[*] [b]Enhanced Combat:[/b] Attack animations and impacts have been revamped for a more dynamic, satisfying experience.
[/list]

We're excited for you to try these improvements! Check out the demo, and let us know if you encounter any bugs or have suggestions. Please also consider leaving us a review on Steam, your feedback helps us immensely!

Roger

notes.title: Update v0.86.4
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Version 0.86.4 includes the following updates and fixes:

[list]
[*] Improved player camera movement to reduce the chance of getting stuck on walls.
[*] Lower difficulty adjustment: Carried weapons are no longer always dropped when hit by an enemy.
[*] Enhanced overall game performance.
[*] Fixed stuttering in full-screen window mode; now defaults to Borderless window mode.
[*] Resolved button issues in gameplay menus.
[*] Added new Game Over menu.
[*] A pop-up menu now appears when changing resolution and attempting to leave the graphics settings.
[*] Adjusted subtitle positioning in the final cutscene.
[/list]
If you notice any bugs or have feedback, please let us know! Your input really helps make the game better. Last but not least, if you could write a review about your experience with the demo, it would mean a lot to us!

Roger
